<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/generate-component-api.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Auto-growing prompt textarea with a submit/stop button, optional attachment controls, and a toolbar slot (model/effort selectors). Enter submits; Shift+Enter inserts a newline; while streaming the button becomes a stop control.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/chat/PromptInput.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { PromptInput } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/chat";
```
